responsibility: This header connects the SPARC backend to the D front end by declaring the helper routines implemented in sparc-d.cc and binding them to the TARGET_D_CPU_VERSIONS and TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO hooks. It is the lightweight interface layer that exposes SPARC-specific D target behavior to the generic D frontend hook machinery.
same_name_distinction: Declares and binds the SPARC D frontend hooks via TARGET_D_CPU_VERSIONS and TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO macros, unlike sparc-d.cc which provides the actual logic. Within the sparc-d pair, this file is only the lightweight interface used to connect the backend to the D hook machinery.
